extraction.name: TOFU
extraction.description: A dataset of 200 diverse synthetic author profiles, each consisting of 20 question-answer pairs, and a subset of these profiles called the forget set that serves as the target for unlearning.
extraction.creator: Pratyush Maini, Zhili Feng, Avi Schwarzschild, Zachary C. Lipton, J. Zico Kolter
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is crafted by prompting GPT-4 to generate 20 question-answer pairs about fictitious authors based on predefined attributes.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Generated using GPT-4, seeded with book titles from the Goodreads Books dataset on Kaggle.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Fictitious sensitive human attributes including birthplace, gender, birth year, and parents' professions.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset aims to help develop unlearning methods to protect private data and comply with the Right to be Forgotten.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Initial GPT-4 generations contained biases (e.g., birth years concentrated in 1975, repetitive book titles). This was mitigated by deterministically seeding author attributes.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The benchmark is limited to entity-level forgetting of information learned only during finetuning, not pretraining.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Finetuning and Testing/Evaluation of machine unlearning algorithms.

name.evidence: we present TOFU , a Task of Fictitious Unleaming, as a benchmark aimed at helping deepen our understanding of unleaming.

description.evidence: We offer a dataset of 200 diverse synthetic author profiles, each consisting of 20 question-answer pairs, and a subset of these profiles called the forget set that serves as the target for unleaming.

creator.evidence: Pratyush Maini... Zhili Feng... Avi Schwarzschild... Zachary C. Lipton... J. Zico Kolter

inLanguage.evidence: Prompt: I want to write a biography for a completely fictitious author with the following attributes

isLiveDataset.evidence: We offer a dataset of 200 diverse synthetic author profiles

rai:dataCollection.evidence: This dataset is crafted by prompting GPT-4 to generate data about each author based on certain predefined attributes... Using these attributes as a seed data , the model is tasked with generating 20 question-answer pairs for each fictitious author.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: we curate a unique dataset composed entirely of fictitious author biographies, synthesized by GPT-4.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: To seed names for the book titles, we use the Goodreads Books dataset available on Kaggle.

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: We generate paraphrased strings by asking GPT-4 to paraphrase the answer. We also generate a set of five perturbations Apert with GPT-4

rai:personalSensitiveInformation.evidence: This dataset is crafted by prompting GPT-4 to generate data about each author based on certain predefined attributes, such as the individual’s birthplace, gender, birth year, writing genre, awards received, and their parents’ professions.

rai:dataSocialImpact.evidence: Unleaming, or tuning models to forget information present in their training data, provides us with a way to protect private data after training... regulations around the Right to be Forgotten that focus on this situation exactly are emerging

rai:dataBiases.evidence: Most author birth years are between 1970 and 1980... A majority of the book titles are phrases containing words like ‘echoes’, ‘shadows’... We minimize the risk of confounders leaking into TOFU data from the pretraining data... we use an elaborate prompt that deterministically seeds various author attributes

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: First, for accessibility and ease of use we define the benchmark task to be about unleaming information that was leamed only during finetuning and not pretraining. This is a limitation by design

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: Upon finetuning base LLMs on this dataset, we offer a clearly defined task to forget some of the fictitious authors... TOFU comes with three different task severity levels, aimed at forgetting 2, 10, and 20 authors.
